overview_description.description:
Liwwa connects small businesses in need of capital with people who want to invest in them. 

The company’s peer-to-peer lease-to-own model addresses the capital access and interest-free investor return opportunities. Liwwa conducts in-house reviews of a small business's creditability and enables them to pay a monthly fee to investors. Founded in 2013, Liwwa raised seed funding with DASH Ventures, al Etihad, and MENA Venture Investments, which it plans to use to hire several new team members, including an underwriting team and to support a new product offering.

about_short_description.short_description: Liwwa is a peer-to-peer lending network that connects investors and small businesses through smart business loans.

product.name: Murabaha Loan
product.description: A Sharia-compliant loan financing business purchases through local or international invoices using a cost-plus financing structure without interest.

product.name: Merchant Cash Advance
product.description: A loan providing working capital based on a business’s proven sales via point-of-sale (POS) machine transaction data.

product.name: Factoring (Invoice and Check Discounting)
product.description: A financing service where businesses receive immediate cash by discounting future-dated checks or invoices from their customers.

product.name: Working Capital Loan
product.description: A loan designed to finance day-to-day business expenses such as payroll, rent, and operational costs for SMEs.
